 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    # The 2-shape has a completely empty horizontal channel between
    # its upper and lower portions; extend that channel in color 3.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for c in range(w)):
            above = any(grid[r - 1][c] == 2 for c in range(w))
            below = any(grid[r + 1][c] == 2 for c in range(w))
            if above and below:
                out[r] = [3] * w
                break
    return out
